accountData.title: My data
accountData.exportHint: Download all your personal data in one file (JSON). It contains:

exportContents.account: your account: email address, name, language, sign-in methods and sessions, plan and quota use, European AI consent, follow-up delays;
exportContents.profiles: your profiles: search criteria, every version of your CV, ATS Score, job searches, Job Digest settings and the Job Digests sent;
exportContents.applications: your applications: job offer, interviews, match score, tailored CV, cover letter, outreach message, follow-ups sent, coach reviews, enriched contacts and company dossier;
exportContents.coaching: your conversations with the AI coach, your coach memory (what it remembers about you), your coach's proposals, the access you granted to human coaches and the coaching sessions you paid for.

accountData.exportLeftOut: It does not contain your sign-in secrets (tokens, unsubscribe link), human coaches' email addresses, our providers' internal identifiers (Stripe, contact data providers) or what each AI reply cost.
accountData.deleteWarning: Your account is closed at once and you are signed out. Your profiles, CVs, applications, documents, the access you gave coaches and your coaching session notes are erased, permanently within 30 days at most. Your subscription, if you have one, ends. Download your data first if you want to keep it.

Other requests, without your identity data, are processed by our usual provider. You can withdraw your consent at any time.

questionnaire.title: Your coach's questions
questionnaire.welcome: Hello, I'm your Jobbbox coach. I'm going to ask you a few questions to build your reference CV. Answer in your own words: you can read it all again and correct it at the end.

questions.fullName: To start with, what is your full name?
questions.targetRole: Which position are you looking for? For example: "Chief Financial Officer".
questions.location: Which city do you live in, or would you like to work in?
questions.email: Which email address can recruiters write to?
questions.phone: Which phone number can they call you on?
questions.jobTitle: Let's talk about your experience. What was the title of job no. {{number}}, starting with the most recent?
questions.employer: Which employer did you hold this job with?
questions.jobDescription: What were your main duties and achievements in this job?
questions.moreExperience: Have you held another job that should be on your CV?
questions.degree: Let's talk about your education. What is your degree or training no. {{number}}?
questions.year: In which year did you obtain it?
questions.moreEducation: Do you have another degree or training to add?
questions.skills: What are your main skills? Separate them with commas.
questions.languages: Which languages do you speak, and how well? For example: "English: fluent, German: basic".
questions.summary: Finally, how would you introduce yourself to a recruiter in a few sentences?

errors.required: This answer is needed to create your profile.

signInProviders.title: Sign-in
signInProviders.intro: The sign-in methods besides the link by email: Google, Apple, Microsoft and any OIDC provider. A change applies within seconds, with no redeployment and nobody signed out. A secret entered here is encrypted and never shown again.
signInProviders.noMasterKey: Saving is off: SECRETS_MASTER_KEYS is not set on this server.
signInProviders.ssoHelp: When on, the back office asks an administrator signed in with a link by email to sign in again with a provider allowed for administrators. Their candidate pages stay open. Permanent super-admins (ADMIN_EMAILS) are never asked.
signInProviders.ssoLabel: Require a sign-in provider for administrators
signInProviders.ssoOn: A sign-in provider is required for administrators.
signInProviders.ssoOff: Administrators may sign in with a link by email.
signInProviders.none: No provider: the link by email is the only way to sign in.
signInProviders.callbackHelp: Paste it in the provider's console (allowed redirect URI).
signInProviders.trusted: links accounts with the same email address
signInProviders.untrusted: does not link accounts: link by email first
signInProviders.appleDates: Signed on {{generated}}, valid until {{expires}}. Next signature: {{next}}.
signInProviders.appleFailed: Signing failed on {{at}}: the super-admins were alerted.
signInProviders.notTested: Not tested since its credentials last changed.
signInProviders.testPassed: {{name}}: the test sign-in passed. You may enable it. Nobody was signed in and no account was created.
signInProviders.testFailed: {{name}}: the test sign-in failed. Check the credentials and the redirect URL in the provider's console.
signInProviders.testNotStarted: The test sign-in with {{name}} could not start.
signInProviders.multiTenantHelp: This Microsoft tenant accepts every directory: any directory admin can give any email address to an account. Accounts are therefore not linked automatically. Choose consumers or your tenant's ID to link them.
signInProviders.idHelp: Lower case letters, digits and dashes, e.g. jobbbox-sso. It is part of the redirect URL and never changes.
signInProviders.tenantIdHelp: consumers (personal accounts), your tenant's ID or domain, or common (every account).
signInProviders.secretHelp: Tested by a sign-in, encrypted, never shown again.
signInProviders.secretKeepHelp: Leave empty to keep the saved one.
signInProviders.shownToCandidatesLabel: Offer it to candidates on the sign-in page
signInProviders.allowedForAdministratorsLabel: Allow it for back office sign-in
signInProviders.trustedLabel: Link an account with the same email address automatically
signInProviders.trustedHelp: Only if this provider verifies email addresses. Otherwise, the person signs in with a link by email first, then links it from "My account".
signInProviders.enabledHelp: A passed test sign-in is needed before a provider is enabled, and after each change of its credentials.

errors.invalid_id: ID refused: lower case letters, digits and dashes, 2 to 32 characters, and not taken by another type.
errors.invalid_display_name: Enter the name on the button (60 characters at most).
errors.invalid_discovery_url: The discovery URL must be an https address.

errors.not_tested: Test sign-in with this provider first: it can be enabled only after a passed test since its credentials last changed.

plans.title: Plans
plans.intro: The Plans offered to Candidates, in the order of the comparison: each is tied to a Stripe product, whose default price is sold at checkout. Prices are set in Stripe, quotas in the Quotas section.
plans.caption: The Plans, from the lowest to the highest
plans.keyHelp: Lower case letters, digits and dashes, for example essential. It never changes.
plans.name: Name
plans.hiddenHelp: A hidden Plan is not in the comparison, at checkout or in Upgrade Prompts. Its subscribers keep it; to move them to another Plan, use Stripe.
plans.productHelp: The product's ID (prod_…), not a price's. The product must be active and have a recurring default price; all its prices give this Plan.
plans.productFrozenHelp: It no longer changes: its subscribers stay on this product. To move them to another Plan, use Stripe.

featureHelp.coachingSessionDiscount: Subscribers pay a session with a Human Coach at the discounted price (STRIPE_PRICE_COACHING_SESSION_PREMIUM).

plans.free: The Free Plan is built in: always first and offered, with no Stripe product. Only its name and quotas change.
plans.createHelp: It is created hidden, above the others, with the quotas of the Plan just below. Offer it once its quotas are ready.
plans.created: {{plan}} Plan created, hidden. Set its quotas, then offer it.

errors.invalid_key: Key refused: lower case letters, digits and dashes, 2 to 32 characters, starting with a letter.
errors.key_taken: Another Plan already has this key.
errors.invalid_name: Give a name in French and in English (60 characters at most).
errors.not_a_product_id: This is not a Stripe product ID (prod_…). A price ID (price_…) will not do: open the product in Stripe and copy its ID.
errors.product_taken: Another Plan already has this Stripe product.
errors.product_not_found: Stripe does not know this product. Check the ID and the mode (test or live).
errors.product_archived: This product is archived in Stripe.
errors.no_recurring_default_price: This product has no recurring default price (each day, week, month or year) in Stripe.
errors.stripe_unavailable: Stripe could not check the product. Try again in a moment.
errors.product_required: An offered paid Plan must be tied to a Stripe product.
errors.free_plan_built_in: The Free Plan cannot be hidden, moved or tied to a Stripe product.
errors.cannot_move: This Plan cannot go any further.
errors.product_frozen: A paid Plan's Stripe product no longer changes once chosen: its subscribers stay on it. To move them to another Plan, use Stripe.
errors.conflict: Another change to the Plans was saved at the same moment. Try again.

planQuotas.title: Plan Quotas
planQuotas.intro: Changes apply at once to every Candidate on the Plan. Leave a field empty for “unlimited”.
planQuotas.limitHelp: A number, or empty for unlimited
planQuotas.invalid: Check the values: whole numbers from 0, or empty for unlimited.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.intro: The codes Candidates type when paying for a Plan, or receive in a link. They are created in Stripe, which counts how often they are redeemed. Coaching Sessions take no coupon.
coupons.caption: The coupons, newest first
coupons.unavailable: Stripe is not answering: the coupons cannot be listed for now.
coupons.codeHelp: Letters, digits, dashes or underscores, 3 to 40 characters, for example SPRING50. Candidates may type it in lower case.
coupons.deactivateHelp: A deactivated code can no longer be redeemed; discounts already given run their course.
coupons.createHelp: The code is created in Stripe with its terms, which then no longer change. To change them, deactivate it and create another.
coupons.valueHelp: A percentage from 1 to 100, or an amount in euros (the Plans must be sold in euros), for example 5 or 4.50. At 100%, the Candidate subscribes without a card; when the free period ends with no card, they are back on Free at once.

durations.forever: For as long as the subscription lasts

coupons.durationInMonthsHelp: From 1 to 36, for the duration "For a number of months".
coupons.plansHelp: The code only applies to the Plans ticked (their Stripe products).
coupons.expiresAtHelp: Optional: the code works until the end of that day (Paris time).
coupons.firstPaymentOnlyHelp: Refused to Candidates who have already paid anything, a Coaching Session included (Stripe's rule: first payment, not first subscription).

errors.invalid_code: The code must be 3 to 40 characters: letters, digits, dashes or underscores.
errors.code_taken: An active coupon already has this code.
errors.invalid_discount: Enter a percentage from 1 to 100, or an amount in euros above 0.
errors.invalid_duration: Choose a duration; for a number of months, from 1 to 36.
errors.plan_not_sold: Only paid Plans tied to a Stripe product can take a coupon.
errors.invalid_expiry: The expiry date must be after today.
errors.invalid_max_redemptions: The maximum redemptions must be a whole number above 0.
errors.unknown_coupon: This coupon does not exist in Stripe.
errors.stripe_unavailable: Stripe is not answering: nothing was done. Try again in a moment.
errors.amount_covers_price: A fixed amount "for as long as the subscription lasts" must stay below the price of each Plan ticked: otherwise that Plan would be free for good.
errors.currency_not_eur: A Plan ticked is not sold in euros: use a percentage for it.

coupons.unreadable: Unreadable: Stripe gives this code without its terms. See it in the Stripe Dashboard.

humanCoaches.emailTaken: A coach already uses this email address.
